LanguageData.Bullet_PNA_Low.label: PNA Projectile
LanguageData.Gun_PNA_Low.label: PNA Launcher
LanguageData.Gun_PNA_Low.description: Uses compressed air to fire aphrodisiac nanofluid projectiles. Repeated hits can render an ordinary person unconscious. A sex slave whose body already coexists with purple nanomachines instead becomes activated as wounds draw closed. Its aphrodisiac effect does not affect Masters.
